mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns, or average 20-day returns in low-rate periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 217.5) triggers anticipated monetary tightening, increasing equity risk premiums and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 217.5, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 550) and retail sales (RSAFS > 350000) signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window, or 20-day returns are negative in >55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) triggers aggressive monetary policy easing, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100.0) reflects expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window for INDPRO predicting 60-day SPX returns, or average 60-day returns in rising INDPRO periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market downturn (HOUST < 550) creates economic headwinds from reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST < 550, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicates aggressive monetary stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window, or 20-day returns are negative in >55% of triggered instances.
